description: This file defines the ReadableProductList class, which is a serializable container for a list of ReadableProduct objects and a total count, providing getter and setter methods for its fields.

classes.name: ReadableProductList
classes.description: A Java class that encapsulates a list of ReadableProduct objects along with a total count, implementing Serializable for object serialization.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of ReadableProduct objects.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of ReadableProduct objects.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total count of products.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of products.
